clue.text: Put that in your pipe and smoke it!

definitions.text: Put that in your pipe and smoke it!

parts.words: Put that in your pipe and smoke it!
parts.note: the retort meaning 'accept it like it or not' is read literally: the thing you pack into a pipe and light

explanation.surface: A defiant retort ending an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Pipe smokers fill the bowl with dried cured leaf and light it.

clue.text: On route where trains made bad time

indicators.note: the letters are spoiled, going wrong into a new order

explanation.surface: Railway journeys took a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods in transit are on their way, travelling along the route.

clue.text: Brought up by a Dutch town

parts.note: bred means raised, reared

explanation.surface: A child was raised by a Dutchman.
explanation.definitionFit: A town in the southern Netherlands.

clue.text: Wicked light thrown on such a dinner?

definitions.text: Wicked light thrown on such a dinner?

parts.words: Wicked light thrown on such a dinner?
parts.note: 'wicked' sounds like evil but means having a wick, a flame lighting a romantic meal

explanation.surface: Something sinister is revealed about a dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic meal lit by flames on wicks.

clue.text: Admitted being kept

explanation.definitionFit: To own up is to confess, and to own is to possess.

clue.text: Went round, distantly attracted

definitions.meaning: circled, travelled in a loop about something
held by gravity from afar, as a moon is by its planet

explanation.surface: Someone circled at a distance, drawn in without coming close.
explanation.definitionFit: A satellite circles its planet while gravity pulls it across a distance, so both senses fit one circling body.

clue.text: Fierce attack on way giggle is stifled

indicators.note: the laugh is smothered, held inside the way

parts.note: ST is street, a way
a giggle is a laugh

explanation.surface: Someone suppresses laughter while en route to an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a violent assault.

clue.text: In bad humour, bishop should read this?

definitions.text: In bad humour, bishop should read this?

indicators.note: the bishop is placed in the bad humour

parts.note: bile was one of the four humours, linked to bad temper
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A grumpy bishop should turn to scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: The old medicine of four bodily humours made bile the cause of ill temper.
explanation.definitionFit: The scriptures are what a churchman is expected to read.

clue.text: Chatting with rating

explanation.definitionFit: Speaking to someone, or a telling-off given as a reprimand.

clue.text: Doctor, anything to take as medicine?

parts.note: aught is an old word for anything

explanation.surface: A patient asks the doctor for something to take.
explanation.definitionFit: A draught is a dose of liquid drunk as a remedy.

clue.text: A writer's gone round a number of mountains

indicators.note: the writer's letters have gone round, enclosing the number

parts.note: a pen is a writer, and the possessive gives the plural-looking PENS
nine is a number

explanation.surface: An author has wandered around some mountain range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gone round' puts NINE inside PENS, giving PEN-NINE-S after the opening A.
explanation.definitionFit: This range runs the length of Italy, a chain of peaks.

clue.text: Ring given to a girl

parts.note: to ring is to sound a bell; a bell is a ring

explanation.surface: A ring is presented to a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Bella is a girl's first name.

clue.text: Son gets manor-house in will

parts.note: a hall is a large country residence

explanation.surface: A son inherits the family estate under a will.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are auxiliary verbs expressing the future, as in 'I will/shall go'.

clue.text: Feigned an injury, so preventing hearing

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are damaged, knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone faked being hurt to escape a court hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injury' rearranges FEIGNEDAN; 'hearing' looks like a court session but is the sense of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A very loud noise blocks the ears, making a listener unable to pick out sound.

clue.text: Fabric for robe will get no modelling

indicators.note: shaping as a sculptor does, so the letters are remoulded into another order

explanation.surface: A bathrobe will look poor if nobody models it.
explanation.definitionFit: Terry cloth, the absorbent looped cotton, is used for bathrobes.

clue.text: Philanderer more knowledgeable about sultanate

indicators.note: the outer word goes about, surrounding the inner one

parts.note: wiser means having more knowledge
Oman is a sultanate in Arabia

explanation.surface: A womaniser knows more about a sultan's realm.
explanation.definitionFit: A man who chases many women, a ladies' man.

clue.text: Tax-man moved from nicer post

indicators.note: the letters shift away from their places into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A revenue official left a pleasant job.
explanation.definitionFit: A tax inspector is an official checking returns.

clue.text: This turn conceals good view

indicators.note: the jumbled letters hold another piece within them
the word is given a turn, its letters spun into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A bend in the road hides a fine panorama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' makes SIHT from THIS, and 'conceals' puts G inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sight is something seen, a vista or spectacle.

clue.text: Smooth breakwater protecting quiet bird

parts.note: to sand is to smooth with abrasive

indicators.note: the pier guards something kept within it

parts.note: a pier is a structure jutting into the sea
P is piano, quiet in music

explanation.surface: A calm sea wall shelters a wading bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A small wading shorebird.

clue.text: Yours truly in bed, a heavenly body

indicators.note: one piece lies inside the bed, as a sleeper would

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
the writer referring to themself, so ME

explanation.surface: Lying in bed, someone is a divine figure.
explanation.definitionFit: An icy object with a glowing tail travelling round the sun is a celestial object.

clue.text: Warnings about very vulgar food

parts.note: CA is circa, about
eats is slang for food

explanation.surface: Health notices about junk food.
explanation.definitionFit: Caveats are cautions or provisos.

clue.text: Presided in court, note -material for bench?

parts.note: a chair sat over a meeting
to court is to woo
D is a musical note

explanation.surface: A judge sat in court; note the wood used for the bench.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bench' suggests a judge's seat, matching the court picture, but here it is a piece of furniture made of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A glossy hardwood used by cabinet-makers for furniture.

clue.text: Deprive English Father standing trial!

indicators.note: standing trial means being in the dock, so one piece stands inside the other

parts.note: the dock is where the accused stands at trial
E is English
FR is the abbreviation for Father, a priest

explanation.surface: An English priest on trial is stripped of office.
explanation.definitionFit: To defrock is to strip a cleric of priestly status, depriving him of office.

clue.text: It produces oil with zeal -even uranium, after a fashion

indicators.note: in some manner or other, so the letters are put together loosely in a new order

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A petroleum nation pursues its industry zealously, even with nuclear fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: The South American country has huge petroleum reserves.

clue.text: Divided into areas, working in last of series

indicators.note: one piece is put in the other

parts.note: zed is the last letter of the alphabet series
on means operating, working

explanation.surface: Areas are mapped out at the end of a series.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last of series' looks like a letter pick, giving S, but means the final letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Land zoned is split into designated districts.

clue.text: Notice politician's spontaneous speech

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
Lib is a Liberal politician

explanation.surface: A politician's notice prompts an off-the-cuff talk.
explanation.definitionFit: An improvised remark, said without preparation.

clue.text: Academic hid nothing in demonstration

indicators.note: the academic hid something inside, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: a prof is a professor, an academic
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A professor concealed nothing in his demonstration.
explanation.definitionFit: A proof is evidence that shows something is so.

clue.text: In Australia, one found fresh air

parts.note: Oz is a nickname for Australia

explanation.surface: Someone found clean air down under.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone is informal for invigorating seaside air.

clue.text: But this crime doesn't attract light punishment

definitions.text: But this crime doesn't attract light punishment

parts.words: But this crime doesn't attract light punishment
parts.note: read as a statement about sentencing, but 'light' means setting fire: a crime that does involve lighting

explanation.surface: A serious offence earns a harsh sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately setting fire to property is a crime that literally involves putting a light to things.

clue.text: One's far from using such a lens

definitions.text: One's far from using such a lens

parts.words: One's far from using such a lens
parts.note: seems to say someone does not use the lens, but it means the user is far from the subject

explanation.surface: Someone is nowhere near using a particular lens.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-focus camera lens lets a photographer shoot distant subjects.

clue.text: Extremely short jockey is energetic walker

indicators.note: taking only the extremes, the first and last letters of the word

parts.note: a jockey is a horse rider

explanation.surface: A very small jockey walks briskly.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who walks with long, vigorous paces.

clue.text: Violently angry British king arresting Irish

indicators.note: the outer letters take hold of another piece and keep it inside

parts.note: Erse is the Irish Gaelic language
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A furious British monarch has an Irishman arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: Going berserk means flying into a frenzied rage.
